elements.name: Neptune
elements.text: Neptune: dreams, mystery, and surrender, the fluid, hidden depth that dissolves rigid boundaries.

elements.name: Crossed legs
elements.text: His legs crossed like a yoga position: even hanging upside down, a body settled into stillness rather than struggle.

elements.name: Serene face
elements.text: His calm, unbothered expression: not suffering but pausing, a surrender that leads to greater awareness.
